data.title: SharpLink CEO warns EIP-8363 could kill ETH’s biggest advantage over Bitcoin
data.description: The "Tapered Issuance Burn" proposal would phase in a rising burn of consensus rewards to limit the amount of ETH staked.
data.keywords: Sharplink ETH, EIP-8363, Ethereum Staking, ETH Staking, Chalom, ETH Staked
